headline: Microsoft ships an emergency fix for its September Windows 11 patch
summary: Three outlets report an out-of-band Windows 11 update fixing problems the September patch introduced. They disagree on whether the USB audio fault is resolved: one says the update fixes it, another that some USB audio stays silent. One outlet also reports crashes on AMD, HP and Lenovo systems.
